g.text: End-to-End System Architecture & Cryptographic Privacy Boundary Specification
Evaluator, Borrower, or Lender Client Environment
• Authorizes Proof Dispatch & UTXO Fee Balancing
• Proof server interaction & ZKIR constraint generation
• Fee balancing & DUST transaction submission pipeline
Off-Chain Helper Only · NOT Blockchain Source of Truth
• Optional indexing helpers & agreement metadata cache
• Does NOT control smart contract or execute private circuits
• Canonical truth is determined strictly on-chain by Midnight
Off-Chain Private State Isolation vs. On-Chain Consensus Verification
• Borrower net annual income or debt-capacity metric (e.g. $85,000 / Uint<64>)
• Evaluated strictly inside ephemeral memory in client-side witness provider
• NEVER written to public ledger, never signed, never sent over the wire
• Circuit: verifyEligibility() executes against local prover key
• Generates zk-SNARK proof of solvency without revealing secret numeric input
• Ephemeral secret value is wiped from memory immediately after proving
• Ledger asserts: isEligibilityVerified = true (strictly via ZK proof verification)
• Consensus verifies zk-SNARK proof against on-chain verification key
• Public observers & lenders learn ONLY that borrower qualifies (Threshold met)
• Public Parameters: Borrower PK, Principal Amount, Rate Basis Points, Duration
• Lifecycle State: Status advances to FUNDED once lender calls fundLoan()
• Repayment: Exactly enforced by contract math (Principal + Interest integer division)
• Zero confidential financial documents, income figures, or bank records on ledger
INVARIANT: DETECTED ≠ CONNECTED ≠ TRANSACTION CAPABLE ≠ NETWORK COMPATIBLE ≠ CONTRACT READY
5-Phase Agreement State Progression with Strict Euclidean Math Obligation Guarantees
Automated CI/CD Validation Pipeline & Verified On-Chain Contract Metadata
Clean Runner Guarantee: Runs on standard ubuntu-latest runners without requiring deployer seed,
private credentials, or local wallet state. CI validates code; deployment is deliberate via CLI.
LOCAL DEMO DATA ≠ ON-CHAIN LEDGER · LOCAL TRANSACTION RECORD ≠ PROVIDER-CONFIRMED STATE · WITNESS IS EPHEMERAL & CLIENT-ONLY
